items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Mm-hmm' to the interviewer's statement that Uncle Henry was the interviewer's father's brother.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: Uncle Henry played guitar, but he was a long serenader. Mm-hmm. That was my father's brother. Yeah. Younger than my daddy, but he was a long serenader.

items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: John learned from my uncle Henry major in the country.

ctx.x: And where did John, who? Where did John learn?
John learned from my uncle Henry major in the country. Mm-hmm. There's a great guitar player. Mm-hmm. Down Creekmore. St. Menard Parish. Eh? Down St. Menard Parish. Down St. Menard Parish.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: That's what he would know it better by St. Menard Parish.
